message: You know, the last time the power went out, I realized my emergency kit consisted of a flashlight with dead batteries and a can of beans from 2008. 😅 It was a funny reminder that being prepared doesn’t have to be overwhelming—it can actually be quite simple! The Red Cross has some great tips for gathering supplies that might just save you from an unexpected adventure (or a hungry evening). What’s one thing you think you’d need in a pinch?
